description: This file is a shell script that manages service lifecycle actions (start, stop, restart) for a system component, including initialization, network setup, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the system configuration by retrieving provisioning data and checking for errors.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the service, sets system parameters, and initiates network services.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service, shuts down network interfaces, and reboots the system.
